breakdown.description: A fully miscible binary polymer blend is typically associated with a single glass-transition temperature, whereas two distinct T_g values suggest phase separation / immiscibility.

The generated text explicitly states, 'The binary polymer blend consists of two immiscible polymers, not a fully miscible blend as initially described,' and further explains that two T_g values indicate immiscibility.
